articles.title: Horoscope for Friday, July 31, 2026
articles.description:
Moon Alert

After 7:30 a.m., there are no restrictions to shopping or important decisions today. The moon is in Pisces.

Aries (March 21-April 19)

An average day

This might be a restless day for you. Nevertheless, you have options to socialize and have fun — perhaps in the entertainment world, or with sports events or playful activities with kids. You're full of different ideas today, which might create detours and surprises for you.

Taurus (April 20-May 20)

A positive day

This is a lovely day to socialize. However, expect to be surprised by someone, because a friend or a member of a group might do something that catches you off guard. Alternatively, you might meet a real character today, or someone you already know might amaze you.

Gemini (May 21-June 20)

An average day

Tread carefully around authority figures today — parents, bosses, teachers, VIPs and the police — because something unexpected could happen. (“Busted!”) To be on the safe side, give authority figures a wide berth. Meanwhile, relations with relatives, siblings and neighbors are rewarding.

Cancer (June 21-July 22)

A positive day

Sudden opportunities to travel might fall in your lap today. Alternatively, planned schedules and itineraries might suddenly change at the last minute. If this is a possibility for you, double-check all details to avoid unnecessary disappointments and glitches.

Leo (July 23-Aug. 22)

A positive day

Make friends with your bank account because something related to shared property, inheritances and the resources you share with others might be subject to a sudden change today. Make sure you know what's going on. Meanwhile, competition with groups and friends might rev your engines.

Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22)

An average day

Be prepared for something unexpected from a partner, spouse or close friend today. (For some, this could relate to a parent or another authority figure.) Basically, something unusual or a bit out of the ordinary might occur. They might make a suggestion that catches you off guard. Be ready.

Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22)

A positive day

Equipment breakdowns and technological glitches might impact your work today or even your health. Pet owners should be extra vigilant because something unpredictable could affect their pets. Keep your eyes open. Give yourself extra time so you have wiggle room for the unexpected.

Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21)

An average day

Social plans are unpredictable today. You might receive an unexpected invitation, or a planned event might be canceled or changed. Meanwhile, romance is full of surprises as well. Parents should be vigilant to avoid accidents with their kids.

Sagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21)

An average day

Your home routine might be interrupted today. Small appliances might break down or a minor breakage could occur. Someone unexpected might appear at your door. Take a breath and cope with whatever is happening. It's nothing you cannot handle.

Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19)

A positive day

Take extra precautions today because this is a mildly accident-prone day for you. Be mindful and aware when walking, jogging or driving. On the upside, you might have some clever, genius-like ideas because it's easy for you to think outside the box. A little surprise might await you today.

Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18)

An average day

Do whatever you can to protect your belongings from loss, theft and damage today because this could occur. On the upside, you might find some money. On the downside, you might lose some money. Things are unpredictable today regarding your assets and resources.

Pisces (Feb. 19-March 20)

A positive day

Today the moon is in your sign; however, it is at odds with unpredictable Uranus, which might prompt you to jump to hasty conclusions. You might feel rebellious. Certainly, you want to be free to do your own thing. You have a strong craving for excitement and adventure, which means there's a strong likelihood that's precisely what you will find!

If today is your birthday

Actress Annie Parisse (1975) shares your birthday today. You're energetic, determined and focused. You love to learn, investigate and be involved. Your creativity and zest for life are at a pinnacle this year. Nurture the happiness and beauty you have within. Let your guard down and loosen up a bit. Have fun, but remember your goals.

articles.title: Drones offer alternative to balloons for weather research
articles.description: Pre-programmed flights gather data at different altitudes then return to bases to recharge and download Weather happens in the boundary layer, the atmosphere from ground level to a few thousand metres, but this can be difficult to study in detail: weather stations are too low, and aircraft are expensive. Instrumented weather balloons are the traditional solution, and thousands are released every day. But these are at the mercy of the wind and use irreplaceable helium. Drones offer an alternative and the US company Meteomatics has taken the idea further with Meteobase , a base station on the ground with a drone that can be launched and recovered automatically. It carries out a pre-programmed flight, gathering data at different altitudes, then returns to recharge and download data which the Meteobase sends to researchers. Continue reading...
